name: eightysix

name: Lolo and Lola

name: Akaluck Restaurant

name: Bento Tei

name: Caffe al Lago

name: Chatkazz

name: CocoNine

name: Ginger & Spice Asian Cuisine

name: Le Bon Melange

name: Moo Moo

name: Noi Noi Vietnamese Kitchen

name: Ogawa

name: Mirchi

name: Assembly

name: Monster

name: TAIWA SUSHI

name: Wonderburger
blurb: Retro 1950s-60s diner vibe with burgers, crinkle-cut fries, Chickenettes, soft serve and a hot fudge sundae.

name: Banh Mi Ko

name: Village Cafe & Dining

name: Casey Jones

name: The District

name: Frankies

name: Two Before Ten

name: Chong Co Thai Restaurant & Bar

name: Toots Play Space and Cafe

name: Moo Moo Frozen Yoghurt (Braddon)

name: Oscar's Bakery Cafe

name: Black and White Espresso

name: High Road
blurb: Dickson café standing out for coffee, local produce and wine; brunch by day, European-style bistro dinners Thursday to Saturday.

name: Mr Pasta

name: Bar Outro
blurb: Wine bar and listening lounge from the Terra and Recess team, with snacky plates like charred prawns and wagyu bavette.

name: Johnny Gio's
blurb: New York-style pizza with hand-stretched dough, plus a short list of pastas and desserts.

name: June
blurb: Refreshed Braddon café known for its blueberry and cream bagel, iced Biscoff latte and chilli scrambled hash.

name: Pizzeria Officina

name: The Mandalay Bus

name: Zero Complex Braddon
blurb: Korean-leaning café with street-food-style dishes, matcha lattes, Korean soft drinks and Three Mills pastries.

name: Banh Mi Nguyen's
blurb: Bistro Nguyen's next-door spin-off built around crisp baguettes and savoury bánh mì fillings.

name: Bar Lola
blurb: Moody Verity Lane Italian bar with fresh pasta daily, an aperitivo list and a kitchen open till 10pm.

name: Bite & Savor
blurb: Sydney Building bakery turning out French-butter croissants and sourdough, with rotating mochi and pistachio croissants.

name: Bloom Room
blurb: Pancake café on Northbourne Ave with flavours like Tiramisu Bliss and Salted Almond Caramel, open from breakfast to dinner.

name: Bombay Duck (City)
blurb: Tuggeranong favourite for spicy skewers and curries, now with a seven-day No Name Lane branch.

name: BUNA
blurb: Rudd Street café for mango panna cotta French toast and an Australian bush honey latte, open mornings to early afternoon.

name: Chichiz Bar
blurb: Queer nightlife bar on Northbourne Ave with drag shows, cabaret, DJ nights and cocktails.

name: Cinnascroll

name: Dissent
blurb: City Walk café-bar that doubles as a live music venue, with mini pizzas and snacks at lunch.

name: Green House Coffee and Food
blurb: Garden-style Canberra Centre café with a terrace facing Mount Ainslie, ONA coffee and guava maple pancakes.

name: House of Desserts
blurb: Build-your-own dessert bar in Verity Lane: crepes, waffles, pancakes, dessert sushi and milkshakes.

name: Lukumades

name: Malatang City

name: Manila in Canberra
blurb: City Walk craft bakery, restaurant and bar in one, with Filipino-inspired dishes and signature cocktails.

name: The Embassy CBR

name: Ve Desi Food

name: Druk Family Restaurant

name: +84 kitchen
blurb: Furzer Street Vietnamese with 12-hour beef bone broth pho, bánh giò and Hanoi-style bún chả.

name: Acai Bunny
blurb: Açaí bowls, shakes and desserts at Westfield Woden, including a viral Dubai-chocolate açaí.

name: Champi Express

name: DeVINO Wine and Salumi

name: Ela Cafe

name: Gluten Free Cafe & Shoppe

name: GravyT
blurb: Indo-Mexican mash-up of burritos, quesadillas, stuffed tacos and fries bowls.

name: Kivotos

name: Leaf Café & Co

name: Mavi Cafe

name: Mazi

name: THE Q DINING
blurb: Elevated Vietnamese in the old eightysix south space: smoky Saigon octopus, Q pho and com tam.

name: Two Sisters Street Food
blurb: Lao-Thai street food trucks known for curry puffs, pad Thai and a Lao chicken laksa.

name: Uni Corner Cafe
blurb: Bowes Street brunch café doing classics like eggs Benedict, for dine-in or takeaway.

name: Andre's Osteria
blurb: Mediterranean-leaning Weston dining room and wine bar: daily-shucked oysters, carbonara arancini and a 400g rib eye.

name: Pronto

name: Namashkar Restaurant
blurb: Anketell Street Indian with goat curry and a pista kulfi dessert people single out.

name: Tap and Toss
blurb: Casual Greenway bistro-pub with steaks, schnitzels, parmis, pizza, draught beer and cocktails.

name: Ken Behrens Burgers & Cafe

name: The Valley Pub

name: Clover Dining
blurb: London Circuit venue blending Italian and Japanese flavours, serving breakfast, lunch and dinner daily.

name: Tintino
blurb: Cosy Kingston wine bar and bottle shop with a global list and comfort food like hibachi lamb belly skewers and truffle toasties.

name: Cartel Taqueria
blurb: Lakeside taqueria on Lake Ginninderra that the article calls legendary for its tacos and margaritas.

name: Florence Gelato

name: Goodberry’s
blurb: Canberra frozen-custard institution known for decadent desserts, sister to the Erindale shop.

name: Grease Monkey Belconnen
blurb: Canberra burger and fried-chicken icon, with a northside shop at Westfield Belconnen since 2025.

name: IKKO

name: Mr B Pastel

name: Society Coffee Co

name: Sweet Business Healthy Living

name: Two Before Ten

name: Double Shot Cafe-Expresso Bar

name: Redbrick

name: Recess

name: Local Press Cafe
blurb: Waterfront café on Kingston Foreshore for build-your-own toast, with vegan and gluten-free options.

name: Penny University Cafe

name: Silo Bakery

name: The Front Cafe and Gallery
blurb: Lyneham café with strawberry rhubarb French toast and a breakfast burger, plus local art exhibitions next door.

name: The Knox made in Watson

name: Knead Patisserie
blurb: Capital Food Market patisserie known for its almond croissant and lemon meringue pies.

name: Kushi Japanese
blurb: Casual izakaya-style Japanese bar with shareable snacks, grilled and fried dishes and drinks.

name: Sushant's Indian Cuisine
blurb: Contemporary Indian at the Capital Food Market, with breakfast options that are often gluten-free.

name: Two Before Ten
blurb: Newest Two Before Ten outpost, known for great coffee and eat-in or takeaway breakfasts and lunches.

name: Goodberry's Frozen Custard

name: Home Brew Cafe & Bar
blurb: Homey family pub in Wright with Ona coffee, local beers, inventive cocktails and plates like burrata and soft-shell crab.

name: Grain De Cafe
blurb: Swinger Hill Shops café with egg-and-bacon rolls, breakfast burritos, homemade scones and a dog-friendly outdoor area.

name: Midnight Mocha
blurb: Furzer Street Nepalese and Indian fusion, with a weekend buffet.

name: Three Mills Bakery
blurb: Woden café-bakery with artisan breads, pastries and hot bakery items on weekdays.

name: Spit Shack
blurb: Weston carwash food truck serving stacked spit-roast rolls and fries on lunch trade.

name: Eighty Twenty
blurb: Belconnen café built on clean, natural, unprocessed ingredients, serving breakfast and lunch every day.

name: A Bite to Eat
blurb: Long-time Chifley local with an eclectic all-day menu and a sunny courtyard.

name: 29 Cafe and Eatery
blurb: Curtin café the neighbourhood rallies behind, loved for bún bò Huế, a rich, hearty alternative to pho.

name: Under Bakery Mawson
blurb: Small-batch, hand-made Mawson bakery known for cardamom bullar.

name: Edgar's

name: Pilot

name: Leyla Bar
blurb: Minimalist seventh-floor rooftop bar with Parliament and lake views, known for martinis and tapas-style plates.

name: Capital Brewing Co

name: Eve

name: Johnny Gio's
blurb: Hand-stretched, Italian-style pizza at the Kingston branch.

name: Dumpling Social (Braddon)

name: AK's Diner

name: Inari

name: Dum Dickson

name: Kagawa Japanese Cuisine
blurb: Woolley Street Japanese restaurant that locals voted a Dickson fan favourite.

name: Mafia Buns
blurb: Tiny Challis Street food van serving burgers and loaded fries, called Dickson's best-kept secret.

name: Wakefields
blurb: Ainslie wine and cocktail bar that hosts guest pop-ups, like a handmade pasta night with Sal's Pastificio.

name: BanMe

name: Tinker Tailor (Casey)

name: Eighty/Twenty
blurb: Coombs café focused on healthy, enjoyable food.

name: Bar Nova
blurb: Loud, retro neon-orange bar-restaurant in the old Onzieme space, with octopus escabeche and skirt steak with chimichurri.

name: Quean Kebabs & Gyros

name: Timur

name: HanCook Korean

name: Tasa Coffee House
blurb: Busy ANU campus café with an all-day Filipino menu: tapsilog, coconut-jam French toast and pork sisig.

name: Lighthouse

name: Romanee

name: Kamusta Filipino Cuisine

name: Cesar's cafe

name: Ambrosia Lounge

name: Common Grounds Gowrie

name: Vanilla Pod Pizza Pasta Bar

name: BUNNY BEANS Café

name: L'epi Artisan Bakery (Kambah)

name: Lava Coffee

name: Tokyo Canteen
blurb: Kingston café mixing Japanese flavours with traditional café fare, a change from the usual coffeehouse.

name: Ricardo's Cafe
blurb: Bright Macquarie café-patisserie open since 2005, with all-day breakfast, specialty cakes and high tea.

name: Mamé

name: Blossom Cafe
blurb: Platypus Centre café known for croffles and savoury brunch, with a play area for kids.

name: Little Italy Village Cafe

name: Bunny Beans Cafe Greenway

name: Cafe Beetroot

name: Chalisa Indian Restaurant

name: eighty/twenty

name: Gisa Sikdang (Suyu Gisa Sikdang)

name: Little Istanbul Restaurant Cafe

name: Mookie

name: Sabrina Gelato

name: Southbound Clubhouse & Grill

name: Street of Asia

name: Tuggeranong Kebabs

name: Ureshi Japanese Restaurant

name: Zucchini Bros

name: Rose 'n' Brew

name: Bella Pizza CBR

name: Braddon Cafe & Liquor

name: MUGII

name: 7 Cutz Steakhouse

name: Back Lane Bird

name: Big Z's Halal Fried Skewers

name: Curiosa

name: Fricken (Canberra Centre)

name: hanoiholic

name: Stacks Sandwich & Coffee Bar

name: Suchi's

name: Ujin

name: Tusa

name: Our Little Café

name: Duck and Goose

name: Cafe Luzon

name: La Veera

name: The Pour House

name: High Sociery Cafe

name: Sticky Rice

name: The Weston Bull

name: Evoke Bakery (Spence)

name: Deeks Health Foods
blurb: Gluten-free and grain-free breads, pasta, pizza bases and biscuits, ordered online for weekday pickup.

name: Barcelona Madrid

name: Barrio Roastery

name: Under

name: Brew & Crust

name: The Lotus Indian

name: Amber Spice
blurb: Kingston Indian kitchen using fresh local ingredients and modern twists on favourites.

name: Hecho En Mexico

name: Nichi
blurb: Minimalist Japanese-style cafe known for hand-whisked matcha and hojicha, good coffee and pastries.

name: The Lounge Room (at Kingsborough)

name: Bakehouse
blurb: Lyneham shops bakery known for hot pies and fresh bread.

name: Illuka

name: Five Passions

name: Birrigai Cafe

name: Daily Brew

name: Kickstart Expresso
blurb: Drive-through cafe open from 6am on weekdays for coffee and country-style takeaway food.

name: Kiln

name: Neutral Grounds
blurb: Long-standing local favourite that's all about good coffee, plus sweet treats and early opening.

name: Stella's on the lake

name: The Irvine

name: Punjabi Hut

name: Joe's Thai Food

name: Turkish Grill
blurb: Local favourite on the Gartside Street restaurant strip for Turkish food.

name: Erindale Vikings (The Cookery, Moo+Brew, Sideline Bar)
blurb: Recently refurbished local club with bistro and bars, a popular neighbourhood hangout.

name: Au Lac Gourmet Vegetarian

name: Folks Gallery

name: My Rainbow Dreams Vegetarian Cafe

name: The Canberra Wine House

name: Two Sisters Lao Thai

name: Gather Cafe

name: On Lonsdale

name: Mocan & Green Grout
blurb: Stylish New Acton cafe with ethical, fair-trade fare like a bacon-egg-relish roll, smoked trout salad and winter soups.

name: Redbrick Coffee (City)

name: Kingston Hotel
blurb: Steak-lover's pub grilling five cuts to order, with sport in the Main Bar and a Garden Bar for cheap weekday schooners.

name: The Dock

name: Old Canberra Inn

name: Duxton

name: Gold Creek Cafe

name: Hungry Bird Cafe

name: Pulp Book Cafe

name: Stripey Sundae

name: Ms Wang

name: Mu

name: Jasper and Myrtle Chocolates

name: Melted Toasted Sandwich Emporium

name: Vietnamese Bakery & Cafe

name: Bubba's BBQ

name: 1919 Lanzhou Beef Noodle

name: Chatterbox Espresso Bar

name: The Hungry Buddha
blurb: Renowned for Nepalese favourites like momos and dhal baat.

name: Espresso Room
blurb: Specialty ONA coffee in the Acton precinct, open weekdays from early morning to mid-afternoon.

name: Ginninderry Espresso

name: Super Bao
blurb: Dickson bao spot for a few shared dishes: pork bao, lobster spring rolls and zucchini chips with a local beer.

name: Taj Agra Indian

name: Tilley Devine's Cafe
blurb: Retro 1984 cafe-gallery with booths and jazz that's famed for atmosphere and a queer, feminist, artistic history.

name: Hyatt Hotel Tea Lounge

name: Corella Bar
blurb: Braddon dinner spot open late Tuesday to Sunday, with BYO Sundays so you can bring your own bottle.

name: Cafe Momo

name: Such and Such

name: Myanmar Corner

name: L'epi Artisan Bakery (Chisholm)

name: The Denman Kitchen + Wine Bar

name: EightyTwenty Dickson
blurb: Corner cafe with a standout unsweetened acai bowl, bagels found only at this branch and strong coffee.

name: Biteful Kebabs
blurb: Kebabs and snack packs at South.Point Tuggeranong.

name: Rubicon Restaurant
blurb: Stylish Griffith modern Australian restaurant open since 2000, praised for staying consistent without chasing trends.

name: Café Blanco
blurb: Neighbourhood Kambah favourite with a seasonal Colombian-influenced menu, tostadas, good coffee and pastries, and Latin American art.

name: Little Theo's
blurb: Kambah favourite where the fish burger is the dish the article recommends.

name: Chimida Coffee Bar Bistro
blurb: Lyneham cafe turned Vietnamese eatery with pho, bun cha salad and made-to-order rice paper rolls, in a relaxed courtyard.

name: Tinker Tailor Jamison

name: Yarralumla Turkish Pide House
blurb: Pide takeaway with nearly 30 years of demand, known for its cheese-pull pide.

name: Brod (Tuggeranong)
blurb: Flame-grilled burgers and Brod dogs at South.Point, with a bar pouring local wines, spirits and beers.

name: Mínima

name: Wildflour
blurb: Fyshwick bakery-cafe known for specialty croissants in flavours like pistachio, ruby chocolate and ube.
